disorder-name.detail: Amyloid-positive patients with confirmed Alzheimer's disease in a real-world clinical cohort.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "We applied neuroanatomical normative modeling to magnetic resonance imaging from a real-world clinical cohort with confirmed AD ( n = 86)."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Imperial Amyloid PET Cohort (APC) from Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The Imperial Amyloid PET Cohort (APC) was established at Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust (ICHT) in 2013 and includes all patients seen at the Imperial Memory Clinic and receiving amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) imaging as part of their diagnostic workup"

sex.detail: Female count/percent reported; male count/percent computed from total n=86.
